statistical_scope: Three joint arrival/service-seed blocks, not96 independent observations. This is descriptive development evidence; no confidence interval or new independent BG confirmation is claimed. No parameter, planning stream, action or service sample is selected from these outcomes.
limitations: This is a measured-phase-derived stochastic complete-frame model with an explicit cross-campaign independence assumption. It is not a measured joint distribution of full native loaded-action executions, a live placement result, a random-service stability theorem or an actual P90 guarantee. Original BG confirmation, planning-stream results and all prior HOLD outcomes remain unchanged.
